title: Rafael and the Autopsy
author: Casper Fairweather
blurb: Jonah Nystrom, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
